name: copy
reason: DFSTree.copy is defined as the identity, so `D.copy = D` holds by rfl and would still hold if Julia's body passed the copied vectors to the constructor in the wrong field order; the body is not mirrored and the statement pins nothing about it.

name: resize!

name: length

name: DFS!
reason: Both listed properties are bounded to 564 CFGs of at most 3 blocks, and the 3-block ones have increasing successor lists only, so the `[dest, num+1]` order that compute_basic_blocks gives a forward branch (for example `1 -> [3, 2]`) never drives the DFS.

name: DFS

name: DomTreeCache

name: construct_postdomtree

name: SNCA!
reason: Bounded to CFGs of at most 3 blocks, where every forward `snca_compress!` call is a no-op (`u = ancestors[v] < last_linked` always holds), so forward the path-compression branch of SNCA! is never tested; the general statements are todo.

name: snca_compress!
reason: With at most 3 blocks the update branch (lines 454-459) never runs forward and only one level of recursion is possible in post-dominance, so a version that compresses one level only (or nothing, forward) passes every listed check.

name: snca_compress_worklist!
reason: The push branch (lines 476-479, `ancestors[u] >= last_linked`) needs a chain `v > u > ancestors[u] >= last_linked >= 2`, so at least 4 reachable blocks; with at most 3 blocks it never runs and a worklist version without it passes, and the check compares against a hand copy of SNCA!'s prefix (sncaSemisWith) with the variant forced rather than chosen by `length(ancestors) <= 32`.

name: domtree_insert_edge!

name: domtree_delete_edge!
reason: delete-sound-small is bounded and weak (an update that recomputes the DFS tree and then sets every idom to 0 still gives exact bb_unreachable and no false dominance); the refuted rebuild-equality entry is a real universal statement with a reproducer, but its counterexample has blocks with three successors and an entry block without fallthrough, which compute_basic_blocks cannot produce, and the only caller (kill_edge_terminator!) reads the tree through bb_unreachable alone, so no effect on real compilation is shown.

name: is_parent

name: rename_nodes!
